name: Admin Accounting Filters
description: Superuser filters the incomes list client-side. Every dimension takes SEVERAL values at once (BaseSegmentedMulti, a role="group" of aria-pressed toggles): period date range, total amount min/max, Tipo (Esperado/Líquido/Pérdidas), Cobro (Sin pagos/Parcial/Pagado, mirroring the row payment badge), Socio, Contabilidad, plus the Cliente/Proyecto/Origen checkbox dropdowns, free-text search with debounce, active-filter count badge and reset. Values inside a dimension are OR'd and dimensions are AND'd — a hint line in the panel says so — and "Todos" clears the dimension rather than being a value in it. The applied-filter chip carries one entry per dimension listing the values chosen in it ("Cobro: Sin pagos, Parcial"), each removable on its own; a single-value dimension reads exactly as it always did. The landing tab "Esperados por cobrar" (id expected-pending) covers pending AND partial: as "Solo esperados" it meant pending only, so an expected income that had received an abono disappeared from the view that promises everything still uncollected. Tabs carry counts, and the active filters travel in the URL so a multi-value cut can be shared. Saved tabs keep a base_filters restore point: edits auto-save, a drifted tab shows a '•' and offers "Restaurar filtros" / "Fijar como base"; the drift comparison reads a scalar and its one-element array as the same cut, so tabs written before the move to multi-value do not report phantom drift.
